about: F-250 head unit: the 7-inch display flush behind the radio opening (ADR-0047). Millimetres, seen from the driver's seat: origin at the cover glass's bottom-left corner on its front face, X right, Y up, Z into the dash. Each expr is a Fusion user-parameter expression in mm, evaluated in order; build_head_unit.py turns them into user parameters and dimensioned sketches. Display numbers: drawing LMD-D/5624/KIT-LC-V3 rev 003 (Raspberry Pi RP-008246-DS), whose back view is mirrored. Status: DESIGN, NOT FITTED.

parameters.name: glass_t
parameters.comment: glass thickness (0.7 +-0.1 on the side view); reference body only

parameters.name: module_t
parameters.comment: glass front to the metal back, drawing

parameters.name: va_right
parameters.comment: viewable area from the glass's right (and left) edge, drawing

parameters.name: va_top
parameters.comment: viewable area from the glass's top edge, drawing

parameters.name: frame_right
parameters.comment: metal back from the glass's right edge (the back view's left), drawing

parameters.name: frame_y
parameters.comment: metal back above the glass's bottom edge, drawing

parameters.name: m3_edge
parameters.comment: M3 holes in from the metal back's right edge and bottom, drawing

parameters.name: insert_d
parameters.comment: M3 heat-set insert hole (set for the inserts bought)

parameters.name: template_gap
parameters.comment: template drawn this far in front of the glass (view only)

parameters.name: notch_w
parameters.comment: template's top-edge notch: this side up

parameters.name: rail_t
parameters.comment: rail thickness; the display's M3 screws pass through it

parameters.name: rail_half
parameters.comment: rail reaches this far inboard of the display's M3 holes

parameters.name: ear_w
parameters.comment: ear beyond the glass's side edge for the truck's brackets (example until H35)

parameters.name: ear_insert_y0
parameters.comment: ear inserts this far from the bottom and the top

parameters.name: box_insert_y0
parameters.comment: rear-box inserts this far from the bottom and the top
